prompts.tutor:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: wide 16:9 educational video insert, 1536x864.
Primary request: a candid realistic high-school student studying algebra at home at night, showing the learner doing the work. Photographic editorial style, natural proportions, real skin and fabric texture, warm lamplight.
Composition: camera beside the student's shoulder, medium close scene. A teenager in an ordinary muted olive sweater occupies the left third in profile, focused and holding a pencil over their own attempted algebra on paper. An open normal-sized laptop occupies the right half, its display facing almost square-on toward camera and clearly visible, with all four display corners unobstructed. The laptop display is a completely plain pale off-white rectangle, no text or interface; precise educational UI will be added afterward. Keep display large enough to read, at least 45% of image width. Desk and paper visible across foreground. The paper has just a few authentic handwritten algebra marks. Cozy modest bedroom, dark window and warm desk lamp subtly in background. Natural documentary photograph, no cartoon, no staged smile, no brand, no watermarks, no overlay titles. Student's hands and pencil anatomically plausible. Horizontal 16:9 frame.
prompts.tutorCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided photographic scene for an educational video. Preserve the exact student, pose, lighting, laptop geometry and completely blank offwhite screen, camera composition and realistic style. Make just these corrections: remove every decorative slogan from the mug and wall poster (plain ceramic mug, simple unlettered wall art); the visible notebook must contain only the two handwritten lines "2x + 3 = 11" and "2x = 8", with blank paper below, as the learner has not finished yet. No x=4 or other final solution. Keep the student holding their pencil, normal anatomy, same 16:9 framing.
prompts.phone:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 educational video photograph.
A close-up of an unbranded smartphone held upright in a teenager's left hand at an ordinary wooden student desk, in soft natural daylight. The phone is the subject, vertically centered, nearly square to the camera with minimal perspective, very large, about 90 percent of frame height. Its portrait screen is a completely blank offwhite rectangle with no UI or text; a predictive keyboard will be added precisely afterward. Four inner screen corners fully visible, no notch cutting into the image, slim rounded black bezel. Left thumb rests along the outside edge without obscuring screen. Right index fingertip is poised just OUTSIDE the right edge of the phone near the screen's lower half, ready to tap but not covering screen. Realistic anatomy, only two hands, ordinary olive sweater cuff. Out-of-focus closed notebook, pencil and modest desk setting. Authentic editorial photograph, not illustration or 3D. No brands, labels, titles or watermark. Frame landscape 16:9; phone screen must be legibly large.
prompts.recall: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the provided student-at-desk photograph. This is a later moment in the SAME study session. Preserve exactly the student identity, olive clothing, camera angle, warm light, bedroom, laptop screen corners and its completely blank offwhite screen, and closed reference books. The student is now testing their memory. Change their gaze slightly downward and pencil position to actively writing a fresh answer on the notebook. The notebook is a fresh blank page with only a small handwritten "x = 5" near the pencil tip, clearly the student's own answer, and no copied problem or notes anywhere on the page. Natural hand anatomy. Keep the mug and wall art without slogans, no new objects or overlay text. Same landscape 16:9 photo composition.
